steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Sorry, Chief, we still haven't found out about Bai Yi's background info.
You're sitting at your office desk, briefed by the intelligence officer on the work they've done in the past few days.
No need to rush. It could be a long haul, this undertaking. Just be patient, I'm sure you'll find something sooner or later.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Chief...
The intelligence officer looks uneasy.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Is it possible that the intelligence we've got is accurate—She really is just an ordinary Sinner?

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: The rumors and testimonies match up, and your experience with her can also back it up.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Except for those hotheads from the Legion, she doesn't seem to have any connection with any major organization. If there really is something fishy about her, we should've found something already.
Here is something you missed.
That day, when we stormed the fake Whitestone Industries, the owner said some mysterious person had given him start-up capital and Mania weapons...
On only one condition, that he founded his company in Syndicate and named it Whitestone Industries.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: That was just his unsubstantiated claim. Not enough to prove...
It's not enough by itself, of course.
But what interested me was how Bai Yi reacted to the claim...

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Her reaction?
Do you think, based on your own observation, that she is the kind of person who cares about the reputation of Whitestone Industries?
The trap set by that mysterious force was too obvious. There's no doubt they had set the trap for Bai Yi.

And she took the bait, drawn to where her opponent wanted her to be. This might be some tacit understanding between them. But she didn't enter the lair unprepared; she took advantage of me, and the entire MBCC.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: I see...
Ms. Bai is a very good actor, with a small imperfection: she is too eager to prove to me that she's just a harmless good-for-nothing.
Let's play along, until the time has come to expose her for who she is.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Chief, this just in: Our intelligence agency has found out who Rhett Bai is.
The impostor?

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Rhett Bai, Eastsider, gone missing after bankruptcy half a year ago.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: We've just heard from our informer: a man answering the description of Rhett Bai has been spotted at Sartre Street near the Rust. It's likely that he's running back to Eastside.
Men his size are a rarity in Syndicate. This piece of intelligence is probably accurate.
I guess this is our chance to expose Bai Yi. Get our men ready, we've got an arrest to make.
Still no sign of him?
You and your MBCC response team have been lying in ambush for three hours, without hearing a word from those on the stakeout.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: The Eastside-bound ferry service ends in twenty minutes. If we don't act now, we'll have to wait until next week...
If the intelligence is not false, then something might have happened to him.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Should we comb through the area?
We don't have enough men. We might not be able to cover the entire area.
...Ten more minutes; if the target still doesn't show up, we're moving in. We'll give priority to hotels, restaurants, and such.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Copy that.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Time's up, Chief.
No sign of the target for another ten minutes.
The waiting game is over... Move in.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Yes, Chief!

The MBCC response team springs into action, quick and efficient. They're divided into several teams, two of which block the main exits out of the block, and the rest of which start searching the places you've just mentioned.
Two minutes later, you hear back from the response team.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Chief, Region 7-4, we have the target!
Stay there, I'm coming over!

steps.speaker: Intelligence Officer
steps.content: Here it is!
You push open the door, which has been shattered as a result of forced entry, and take in the shambolic room.
The cupboards and desks have been smashed, and the bed is missing a corner. Blood stains are also found.
In the center of the room is a chair to which an unconscious Mr. Bai is tied, his mouth duct-taped, the corners of his eyes moist with tears.
He was in a similar state the last time I saw him...

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Chief, we found this in the room.
You are handed a plastic bag holding a mini-camcorder.
You open the bag, take out the camcorder, and turn it on to view the recorded video.
A terrified big face takes up the entire screen.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: They... They, they are out to get me!

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: The Syndicans are all bad seeds. Gave me money, gave me products, all just a ruse to use me as a tool!

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Now that the cops are after me, they want me dead.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: I... I, I gotta record this. Even if I'm dead, I gotta let the cops have this camera...

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: G-G-Gentleman or l-lady, whoever you are, for the sake of justice in the DisCity, please help make sure my death is avenged...
He's not that stupid after all. But he underestimated his pursuers.
What made him think his pursuers wouldn't find this camera? And even if they knew the video was out, they wouldn't hesitate for a moment about doing what they intended to do.
He took himself too seriously too. He's just a nobody. His death wouldn't cause any ripples.
The video rolls on. Mr. Bai tosses and turns, the bed squeaking under his weight. Nothing much is happening on screen for some time.
You fast forward the video until you hear a suspicious sound, which seems to have come from outside the window of the room Mr. Bai is in.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Who's there?!
The noise startles Mr. Bai. He rises to his feet, comes over to the bed, and picks up the camcorder.
He inches towards the window, attempting to find out what's caused the noise.
A dark shape appears on the screen, moving so fast that it leaves a lingering blur behind, its movements indiscernible.

steps.speaker: Boss Bai
steps.content: Ahhhh...!
The camera is knocked off Mr. Bai's hand, flies across the room, and lands in a corner. It's facing the wall, and on the screen is nothing but blackness, but it's still recording sounds.
Ding—
Then comes a clash of blades. Seems like someone is confronting the attacker.
I knew you guys would get impatient.
How dare you come to challenge me?
The attacker makes no response. All you can hear is the sharp sound of blades.
The noise soon dies down, and it is quiet again.
That's where the video ends.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Chief, what do we do?
Keep Rhett Bai from running away, and I bet there's a trail of blood starting from the window.
Follow the trail of blood. Go!

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Got it!
The response team springs into action, following a trail of blood with the help of a spectrometer.
Presently, you reach a dark alley, where a fight clearly took place not so long ago. Ahead, darkness swallows everything.
An unaccountable unease rises in your chest at the sight of the impenetrable darkness. You stop in your tracks, not sure if you should order your men to continue the pursuit.
If I were you, I'd stop right here.
A familiar voice pipes up in your ear. A gust of wind finds its way into the valley, carrying with it a could of dust. You have to shut your eyes.
I like you a lot. And I admire your bravery.
But sometimes, bravery alone is not enough.
You hear the voice, but you don't see the person speaking.
What is it that you're hiding from me?
Just some dangerous secrets...
Once you learn the secret, you can't unlearn it. Everything you value will come under grave threat.
Do you still want to know?
You swallow hard, eyes focused on the overwhelming darkness.
You'll know the secret, you have to know. But not now...
Be a dear and go home. The time hasn't come yet. Enjoy the last of your peaceful days.
The wind dies down. You realize that barely a minute has passed.
Did you guys hear anything?

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Just the wind.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Did you hear something else?
No.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Should we continue?
You catch sight of a deep mark, courtesy of a sword, on the pavement.
Let's call it a day.
By the time you and the team arrive at the MBCC, it's already early morning. You make your way to the cafeteria, where you find the Whitestone Industries trio in the doorway.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Scan the QR code.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get lost!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Everyone knows that stupid app of yours is full of stupid ads. The Chief had to get a new terminal thanks to you.
Having received a good talking-to from Hella, Bai Yi calls it quits.
Why are you in the mood for work all of a sudden, the mighty Ms. Bai?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: ...K.K. is injured, can't work. And Whitestone is on the brink of bankruptcy...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Bankrupt or not, I don't care about it too much. But the thing is, we really need money. So here I am, being the breadwinner again.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Hehe...

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Breadwinner? Don't make me laugh. It's been half an hour, and not a single soul has come to scan your stupid QR code.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: H-How could you guys be so disrespectful to your boss?! Can't you see how I am working my guts out to provide for you?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: All right, all right, you're the provider.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Hey, Chief, wanna play cards? I hear you've just closed a case. You deserve a break.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Playing cards? I'm in!

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Don't you need to earn money to provide for us?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I've worked for quite a while. I'm all about work-life balance.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: It's only been half an hour.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Let me remind you, this month is almost over, and we haven't got a penny in our accounts.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: If playing cards is off the table, we've got to find something else to do. How about a hotpot?
I don't think the MBCC cafeteria serves hotpots?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Not a problem. K.K.'ll take care of it.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Do you have any idea how miserable my life was when you were kept in the MBCC? All I ate for the whole two months were instant noodles and plain bread. I didn't even have pickled vegetables...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Why didn't you learn to cook then?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Couldn't be bothered.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Oh K.K., my dear friend, could you please make us some hotpot broth? It wouldn't be too much trouble. I'll go get the ingredients...
Che gives you and Bai Yi a grimace and yanks K.K. into the cafeteria, leaving the two of you in the doorway.
You have so many questions to ask her. They come up to the tip of your tongue, but refuse to come out of your mouth.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Am I so scary? Why are you being quiet?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Or maybe you have some little secrets you want to share with me, but you are too embarassed?
...You guys have been keeping things from K.K., right?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Yes...
Why?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Because she's a good kid, and she... means a lot to me. I don't want her to be dragged into this mess.
What about Che?
Bai Yi smiles.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Che escaped from that mess, just like I did.
So you were the one in BR-004, weren't you?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: What if I was?
I want to know the whereabouts of Zoya.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Ah, you're such a caring person...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: She is in a place no one can find. God, wish you could be so caring to me.
I value you a lot too. But Zoya's safety...
Bai Yi closes your mouth.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: No more questions, please.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Let's go enjoy the hotpot. K.K. makes the best broth. You don't want to miss it.
Wait...
...Forget it. One of these days, I'll find out what game you're playing.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Oh... Really?
Bai Yi's expression is neutral, but you see a ghost of a self-satisfied smile flit across her face, there is no denying it.
